caption: The drawing consists of three black line illustrations of spoons on an off-white or light beige background. The topmost spoon is shown from above, with an oval bowl featuring decorative detailing at the base of the bowl where it meets the handle, and small rectangular marks along the handle. The middle spoon is also viewed from above, with a plain oval bowl and a slightly decorated handle that has small markings or letters near its end. The bottom spoon is shown in profile, displaying the curvature of the bowl and handle, and includes similar decorative detailing at the base of the bowl as seen on the topmost spoon. In the lower left corner of the page, the text "WALTON, K" appears in black. The artwork is monochromatic, with all illustrations and text rendered in black lines.
title: Silver Spoon
